description: This source file contains Go tests for the snapshot functionality in the Android Cuttlefish project. It includes test setup, device creation, snapshot creation, powerwashing, device restore from snapshot, and related helper functions.

methods.name: TestSnapshot
methods.description: Main test function that sets up environment, creates device, performs snapshot operations, powerwash, and restores device from snapshot, verifying device state throughout.

methods.name: uploadArtifacts
methods.description: Helper function to upload necessary artifacts to the server and return the upload directory.

methods.name: createDevice
methods.description: Creates a CVD device with specified configuration on the server.

methods.name: createSnapshot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of the device via HTTP request to the server, waits for operation completion, and returns the result.

methods.name: getCVD
methods.description: Retrieves the first available CVD from the server.
